mlg.logic: Treat a banal hardware detail like an esports miracle. The edit often carries the joke.

surreal.logic: Broken language, bad 3D, impossible but unremarked visual transformations.

writing_rules: The line may be nonsense; the zoom, pause and sound can provide the punchline.
A POI must be visible and must motivate the gag.
Do not turn meme vocabulary into polished marketing slogans.
Physical claims are in specs; impossible statements in jokes are satire.
Mix styles only when the result is funnier than either alone.
comedy_spec.coordinate_policy: POIs have semantic identifiers; model-specific coordinates are null until supplied assets are mapped.
comedy_spec.cue_policy: Presentation cues are optional suggestions, not required sound or visual assets.
